name: zvideo_load_palette_file_and_apply_brightness
description: zVideo::LoadPaletteFileAndApplyBrightness caches an optional palette path, loads the 256-color RGB payload, and applies brightness-adjusted entries through the active palette provider.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this palette-file loader; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo renderer-dispatch/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c7fd0 validates optional strcpy-style caching into g_zVideo_PalettePathBuffer, fopen with rb mode, stderr diagnostic plus 0x800 return on open failure, fread(g_zVideo_PaletteFileEntries, 3, 256, stream), fclose, and tail dispatch to zVideo::ApplyBrightnessToPaletteEntries with g_zVideo_PaletteFileEntries.

The native smoke verifies path caching, the null-path reuse path, exact contiguous 768-byte palette payload loading into the 1024-byte palette-entry storage, dispatch through the brightness/palette provider path, and return-value propagation from the provider.
